inbox_items.title: Notification-router watchdog is dead and its marketing dead-flags are false positives
inbox_items.detail: notification-router/state.json last_run is frozen at 2026-05-08T21:26Z — now 24 days stale. The moteops_marketing.watchdog_dead flag (marketing-director, first_seen 2026-05-04, last_seen 2026-05-08, consecutive_sessions 19, policy_kind info_only) still has no resolved_at. Meanwhile the VP agents ARE running — vp-tracking heartbeats exist for 05-28, 05-29, 05-31 and now 06-01. Conclusion: the watchdog that declared the marketing hierarchy 'dead' is itself stale/stopped; the dead-flag is a stale false positive. Recommend: either restart the watchdog so it tracks the new scheduled-task heartbeats, or decommission it and clear the stale dead-flag so it stops polluting signal.
